name: hindi-arc-c-2.5k
description: A Hindi-language version of the ARC multiple-choice science question set that evaluates models on grade-school science reasoning in Hindi. It measures a model's ability to understand Hindi prompts and select the correct multiple-choice answer requiring factual and commonsense reasoning. The set contains roughly 2.5k examples.
reputation: A niche but useful resource within Indic benchmark collections for evaluating multilingual scientific QA and reasoning.
